const predicateValues: (string | number)[] = ['a', 2];
function annotatedBoolean(value: unknown): boolean { return typeof value === 'string'; }
predicateValues.filter(annotatedBoolean).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
function multipleReturns(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value === 'string') return true;
  return false;
}
predicateValues.filter(multipleReturns).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
function rewrittenParameter(value: unknown) {
  value = 'changed';
  return typeof value === 'string';
}
predicateValues.filter(rewrittenParameter).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
function booleanOverload(value: unknown): boolean;
function booleanOverload(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
predicateValues.filter(booleanOverload).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
class BooleanMethodOverload {
  string(value: unknown): boolean;
  string(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
}
predicateValues.filter(new BooleanMethodOverload().string).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
function maybePositive(value: number | undefined) { return !!value; }
const maybeNumbers: (number | undefined)[] = [0, 1, undefined];
maybeNumbers.filter(maybePositive).map(value => value.toFixed());
function isDeclaredString(value: unknown) { return typeof value === 'string'; }
const rejectedString: unknown = 'a';
if (isDeclaredString(rejectedString)) rejectedString.toFixed();
const rejectedNumber: string | number = 1 as string | number;
if (!isDeclaredString(rejectedNumber)) rejectedNumber.toUpperCase();
function genericBoolean<T>(value: T): boolean { return value !== null && value !== undefined; }
maybeNumbers.filter(genericBoolean).map(value => value.toFixed());
function writesNested(value: unknown) {
  function mutate() { value = 'changed'; }
  return typeof value === 'string';
}
predicateValues.filter(writesNested).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
class RewrittenMethod {
  string(value: unknown) { value = 'changed'; return typeof value === 'string'; }
}
predicateValues.filter(new RewrittenMethod().string).map(value => value.toUpperCase());
